summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Report of Voting Results from its July 22, 2026 special meeting. Shareholders voted 99.83% in favor of approving the issuance of up to 421,770,377 common shares in connection with the company's acquisition of all outstanding shares of Orla Mining Ltd. This Form 6-K is a routine report of voting results following a shareholder meeting, not an announcement of the transaction itself. No deal terms, price per share, premium, or advisory details are disclosed. The filing merely confirms shareholder approval, making it a non-event for special-situations classification.
